uses: enacted labor/copyright reform for performer image/voice AI use
consent, contract conditions, remuneration, and written agreement controls
adjacent non-consensual synthetic-media protection for performers
Article 305 Bis, normalized line 17: labor contracts must specifically stipulate conditions and remuneration for use of image or voice through AI systems or other technology.

Article 87, normalized lines 44-49: image including voice and characters may only be used/published with express consent; protection covers AI-generated results; different use requires new authorization/remuneration; parody/satire/creative imitation exception when not cloning/supplanting or replacing professional performance.

Article 118(VII), normalized line 59: performers may authorize/prohibit AI or other technology supplanting performances, generating clones, or simulating identifiable voice, with parody/satire/creative imitation and substitution-market limits.
Article 121, normalized lines 65-66: AI cloning or supplantation of voice/image requires prior written agreement between parties.
